name: Onboarding Tour shows the not-indexed state for the seeded repo
description: From the PR list, click the WORKSPACE 'Onboarding Tour' sidebar item and confirm the per-repo tour page (/repos/<id>/onboarding, not the Add-repository route /onboarding) renders its never-generated, not-indexed empty state with the Resync action. The seeded repo has clonePath null, so the index is not usable and no model is ever called. Read-only: Resync is not clicked. Assumes the fresh-seed hermetic stack where acme/payments-api is the only repo (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: open the Onboarding Tour sidebar item
the per-repo tour page title renders (not the Add-repository screen)
the single primary action is Resync
